1.11 Archive embedded XMP bytes

./rust-scanner/target/release/dng-subset --archive-xmp \
  /media/source/foto archives/source-xmp

This extracts TIFF XMP tag 700 bytes under packets/, preserving the relative source layout. It records packet size, SHA-256, extraction method and source identity in manifests. On a parser failure it can use ExifTool extraction as a fallback, recorded separately. It does not modify a source DNG.

Per-batch manifests permit resume after checking source stamps and stored packet hashes. The final summary counts files with/without XMP, packets and errors and reports all_xmp_saved. A file with no packet is different from a failed extraction. Existing sidecars are outside this command; preserve them separately. Embedded source XMP is not automatically a current cloud develop packet, and a packet hash must never be renamed to impersonate a different requested hash.
